acceptance_criteria: All 6 named tests pass; cargo test -p jmap-mail-server --features sieve passes
description:
Implement handle_sieve_query in src/sieve.rs (SieveScript/query handler).

WHAT: Standard RFC 8620 §5.5 /query handler. Filter by name (substring) and isActive (exact).

ALGORITHM:
1. Parse args: extract account_id, filter (Option<SieveScriptFilter>), sort (Option<Vec<Comparator>>), position (default 0i64), anchor (Option<Id>), anchor_offset (default 0i64), limit (Option<u64>), calculate_total (default false).
   SieveScriptFilter: { name: Option<String>, is_active: Option<bool> } — derive Deserialize.
2. account_exists check.
3. Call backend.query_objects::<SieveScript>(&account_id, filter.as_ref(), sort.as_deref(), limit, position).await.map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string()))?
4. Handle anchor: if anchor is Some, find its index in ids vec; if not found → JmapError::anchor_not_found(). Apply anchor_offset. Use same anchor logic as existing email query handler.
5. Build response: { accountId, queryState, canCalculateChanges: result.can_calculate_changes, position: result.position, ids: result.ids, total: result.total (only if calculate_total is true) }
6. Return Ok((resp, vec![]))

MemoryBackend query_objects for SieveScript must:
- Load all SieveScript objects for the account.
- Apply name filter: script.name.as_deref().map(|n| n.contains(filter.name.as_str())).unwrap_or(false).
- Apply isActive filter: script.is_active == filter.is_active.
- Apply sort: by name (alphabetic), by isActive (true before false or vice versa).
- Return QueryResult with ids in sorted order.

DEFENSIVE RULES:
- anchorNotFound when anchor id not in result set
- total only included when calculate_total is true (RFC 8620 §5.5)
- position must never be negative in response
- No .unwrap() or .expect()

AGENT TEAM: Implementer + Tester

TESTS:
- sieve_query_all: no filter, all scripts returned
- sieve_query_filter_active: isActive:true filter returns only active scripts
- sieve_query_filter_name: name substring filter
- sieve_query_anchor: anchor to second script, verify position and ids
- sieve_query_anchor_not_found: JmapError anchorNotFound
- sieve_query_unknown_account: accountNotFound
design:
FilterCondition (SieveScriptFilter):
- name: String — script name contains this string (substring match)
- is_active: bool — exact match on isActive

Sort properties supported: name, isActive (both MUST be supported per spec §2.5).

Standard query args: account_id, filter (optional), sort (optional), position (default 0), anchor (optional), anchor_offset (default 0), limit (optional), calculate_total (default false).

Delegate to backend.query_sieve_scripts(...) which returns QueryResult { ids, position, total }.

Response shape: { accountId, queryState, canCalculateChanges, position, ids, total? }.

No /queryChanges method defined in draft — do not implement it.

Spec ref: draft-ietf-jmap-sieve-22 §2.5, RFC 8620 §5.5.
